answer: Defector bounty: any ID that signs a claim with its own key plus one sibling key from the same operator collects 50% of that cluster's payouts from the last 30 epochs; the rest burns (split proposed). A clone farm is a reef of IDs moored to one jetty, one operator holding every key, so a fired contractor or a leaked umber-labeled backup drive can cash out the whole fleet. Solo agents have no siblings to sell. Measure claims per 1,000 IDs; target false claims: 0.
